title: pet
intro:
The ’pet’ component should calculate the potential evapotranspiration from mete-
orological data, as well as the crop and soil state.

     Reference evapotranspiration for a dry system.

sections.name: Makkink
sections.desc:
Potential evopotranspiration using Makkink’s Equation. E M = beta M0 + beta M1
* (s * Si) / (lambda (s + gamma)) .
    E M is the reference evapotranspiration [mm/d]. beta M0 [mm] and beta M1
[] are empirical parameters. Si is global radiation [MJ/m2 /d]. s is the slope of
the vapour pressure curve [Pa/K]. lambda is latent heat of vapourization [MJ/kg].
gamma is the psychrometric constant [Pa/K]. See also [Makkink, 1957]
sections.sig:
< Makkink (use daily temperature true)
                 (beta M0 beta M0 )
                 (beta M1 beta M1 ) >
